description.default: Sign in to ZCode (Z.ai / BigModel GLM Coding Plan) through its browser sign-in. Individual and team-seat accounts speak plain Anthropic Messages; the Start Plan account's outbound disguise is applied by transformRequest and its refusal text by transformResponse. Models and quota are available. Requires Snow App 0.5.6+.

description.zh-TW: 透過 ZCode 的瀏覽器登入加入 Z.ai 或 BigModel（智譜）GLM Coding Plan 帳號。個人訂閱與團隊席次走標準 Anthropic Messages；Start Plan 的出站偽裝由 transformRequest 補齊，被拒文案由 transformResponse 處理。模型清單與額度面板可用。需要 Snow App 0.5.6+。
